correctness.rationale: The suffix-length distribution follows by integrating independent uniforms. Its conditional records have independent Bernoulli(1/j) indicators from uniform relative ranks. The finite mixture recurrence proves the exact rational-polynomial identity; the root factorization proves the log-concavity used for the one-crossing argument; convolution with an independent geometric law converts TV to the finite weighted-mass maximum. Bernoulli Lyapunov and the explicit characteristic-function Gaussian bound justify the uniform lattice local CLT and the sharp constant \(1/\sqrt{2\pi}\). Exhaustive permutations through n=7, rational identities through n=9, and exact small-n TV checks reproduced from the packaged verify.py. The finite checker is not relied upon to establish the asymptotic or universal assertions.

value.rationale: The established geometric record-breaking limit previously supplied only convergence for fixed counts. The new exact all-horizons error formula and one-crossing property make the approximation quantitatively computable, while the sharp \(1/(n\sqrt{2\pi\log n})\) law improves the natural 1/n truncation-coupling bound by a genuine logarithmic factor. The improvement is structurally explained by the spreading random-permutation cycle count and is not a fixed-k or purely cosmetic estimate.
